    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name...")
    await searchbox.fill("AndroidSlidingUpPanel")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)  # Wait for filtering to take effect
    
    # Click on the project link after filtering
    # The project link might be under a heading or in a list item
    project_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="AndroidSlidingUpPanel", exact=True)
    await project_link.click()
    
    # After navigation, wait for the project page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    
    # Now on the project details page, look for contributors or commit statistics

        contributors_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Contributors", exact=False)
        await contributors_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    except:
        # If 'Contributors' link not found, try other common patterns
        try:
            repo_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Repository", exact=False)

            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

            # If still not found, try to find any element that might contain commit data
